{{Short description|Soviet Scientist and Philosopher}}
{{family name hatnote|Georgievich|[[Kuznetsov]]|lang=Eastern Slavic}}{{infobox person/Wikidata|fetchwikidata=ALL|dateformat=mdy}}

'''Pobisk Georgievich Kuznetsov''' ({{langx|ru|Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов}}; May 18, 1924, in [[Krasnoyarsk]] – December 4, 2000) was a Soviet Russian philosopher and scientist (chemist<ref>{{cite web | title=100th Anniversary of birthday of Pobisk Kuznetsov | date=28 April 2024 | url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/380153616 }}</ref>).<ref>{{cite web | url=https://ruskline.ru/video/2024/07/17/pobisk_kuznecov__sovetskii_genii_kotoromu | title=Побиск Кузнецов — советский гений, которому }}</ref> [[Doctor of Sciences]], Professor.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://gtmarket.ru/library/articles/5266 | title=Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов: Проектология – Гуманитарный портал }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://arch2.iofe.center/person/21074|title=КУЗНЕЦОВ Побиск Георгиевич - Электронный архив Фонда Иофе|website=arch2.iofe.center|access-date=2021-08-28|archive-date=2021-08-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210811141621/https://arch2.iofe.center/person/21074|url-status=live}}</ref> He was professor at the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]] and Dubna State University (Moscow region, [[Dubna]] city, Russia).<ref name="auto">{{cite web|url=http://window.edu.ru/catalog/pdf2txt/544/79544/60063|title=Устойчивое развитие: Научные основы проектирования в системе природа-общество-человек: Учебник. Читать бесплатно онлайн в электронном виде &#124; Единое окно|website=window.edu.ru|access-date=2021-08-28|archive-date=2021-08-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210827110859/http://window.edu.ru/catalog/pdf2txt/544/79544/60063|url-status=live}}</ref> He was the last general designer of the [[USSR]].<ref name="cosmatica_1366">{{cite web | url=https://cosmatica.org/articles/1366-traktorist-kuznecov-pobisk-georgievich-kuznecov.html | title=Тракторист Кузнецов - Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов — Русское Космическое Общество }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://gtmarket.ru/library/articles/5266 | title=Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов: Проектология – Гуманитарный портал }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://cosmatica.org/news/928-20-let-nazad-ushyol-v-vechnost-poslednii-generalnyi-konstruktor-sssr.html | title=20 лет назад ушёл в вечность последний Генеральный конструктор СССР — Русское Космическое Общество }}</ref>
He worked for the [[State Duma of the Russian Federation]].<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web| url=http://www.ugolinfo.ru/Free/092007.pdf#page=80 | title=О роли конструктивного мировоззрения Побиска Георгиевича Кузнецова в отраслевых научно-исследовательских работах (угольная отрасль) | language=ru | trans-title=On the role of the constructive worldview of Pobisk Georgievich Kuznetsov in industry research work (coal industry) | access-date=2021-08-28 | archive-date=2021-08-27 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210827114403/http://www.ugolinfo.ru/Free/092007.pdf#page=80 | url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.akdi.ru/gd/sprav_in/15/KOM15-4.HTM|title=Список членов Экспертного Совета Комитета Государственной Думы Федерального Собрания Российской Федерации по безопасности|date=September 30, 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000930031647/http://www.akdi.ru/gd/sprav_in/15/KOM15-4.HTM|archive-date=2000-09-30}}</ref> 

His father was a retired military man and his mother was a Physics teacher.<ref>{{Cite web | title=Биография | url=https://побиск.рф/bio | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203193237/http://xn--90aognep.xn--p1ai/bio | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2023-02-03}}</ref>
He went to school in [[Novosibirsk]].<ref name="pyc_aboutteacher">{{Cite web | title=Слово об учителе | url=https://большаков.рус/aboutteacher | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181016133314/http://www.xn--80abe5adrd1f9a.xn--p1acf:80/aboutteacher | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2018-10-16}}</ref> He then studied in Leningrad.<ref name="pyc_aboutteacher"/>
During the [[Eastern Front (World War II)|war]] he became a [[Junior lieutenant]].
He was awarded the [[Order of the Red Star]] on 1943.<ref>{{Cite web | title=Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов | url=https://побиск.рф | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203205317/http://xn--90aognep.xn--p1ai/ | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2023-02-03}}</ref> He was injured in 1943.<ref>{{Cite web | title=Побиск Георгиевич Кузнецов | url=https://побиск.рф | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203205317/http://xn--90aognep.xn--p1ai/ | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2023-02-03}}</ref> He suffered from Stalin's repression. (He was arrested in 1944.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://ru.openlist.wiki/Кузнецов_Побиск_Георгиевич_(1924) | title=Кузнецов Побиск Георгиевич (1924) }}</ref> He was released in 1954.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://spnikanorov.ru/stati/sovremennye-problemy-i-ih-resheniya/kontseptsiya-p-g-kuznetsova-i-ee-sledstviya/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130926161827/http://spnikanorov.ru/stati/sovremennye-problemy-i-ih-resheniya/kontseptsiya-p-g-kuznetsova-i-ee-sledstviya/ | archive-date=26 September 2013 | title=Спартак Петрович Никаноров - официальный сайт - Концепция П.Г. Кузнецова и ее следствия }}</ref>) He was rehabilitated in 1956.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://ru.openlist.wiki/Кузнецов_Побиск_Георгиевич_(1924) | title=Кузнецов Побиск Георгиевич (1924) }}</ref>
He worked as a [[tractor]] driver.<ref name="cosmatica_1366"/>
From 1955 to 1961 he worked in the [[Ministry of Geology]].<ref name="pyc_aboutteacher"/>

In 1958 he graduated.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=79nEDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT35|title=История героев|first=Степан|last=Зотов|date=September 12, 2020|publisher=Litres|isbn=9785042213809|via=Google Books|access-date=August 28, 2021|archive-date=August 28, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210828110820/https://books.google.com/books?id=79nEDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT35|url-status=live}}</ref> From 1961 to 1964 he is a postgraduate student at the V. I. Lenin [[Moscow State Pedagogical Institute]]. He defended his dissertation for the [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree in 1965. He worked at the V. I. Lenin Moscow State Pedagogical Institute. He headed the laboratory there,<ref name="cosmatica_1366"/> which was created on the initiative of [[Alexander Shelepin]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://zavtra.ru/blogs/nepriznannij_genij | title=Андрей Фурсов: Непризнанный гений }}</ref>
In 1970 he was arrested and placed in a psychiatric clinic ([[Serbsky Center]]).<ref name="cosmatica_1366"/> 
As he claimed, [[Nikolai Shchelokov|Shchelokov]] arrested him.<ref>{{cite web | title=Библиотечный комплекс | url=https://lib.uni-dubna.ru/search/files/pk_idea/~pk_idea.htm }}</ref>
The [[Academy of Sciences of the USSR|Academy of Sciences]] was outraged and he was released.<ref name="cosmatica_1366"/>
He worked together with [[Robert Bartini]].<ref name="cosmatica_1366"/>
Since 1974 he worked at the [[Moscow Power Engineering Institute]]. Then he worked at [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://zarealie.narod.ru/a014.htm|title=Персоны|website=zarealie.narod.ru|access-date=2021-08-28|archive-date=2021-08-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210828085001/http://zarealie.narod.ru/a014.htm|url-status=live}}</ref>

He was the author of 200 scientific papers.<ref name="auto"/> He published in the newspaper [[Pravda]].<ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QbFT9HzhY2EC&pg=PA152 | title=Soviet History in the Gorbachev Revolution | isbn=0-253-31604-9 | last1=Davies | first1=Robert William | date=1989 | publisher=Indiana University Press }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nB6g1tnlSS4C&pg=PA66 | title=Glasnost' in Action (Routledge Revivals): Cultural Renaissance in Russia | isbn=978-1-136-62912-9 | last1=Nove | first1=Alec | date=February 2013 | publisher=Routledge }}</ref>

He was also awarded the [[Order of the Patriotic War]] in 1985, the [[Medal "For Distinguished Labour"]] in 1969.

== Ideas ==
Many of his ideas emerged in the 1940s.<ref name="pyc_aboutteacher"/> What mattered was that in 1947 he learned about [[biophoton]]s.<ref name="pyc_aboutteacher"/> He developed the ideas of [[Russian cosmism]].

[[Viktor Afanasyev (politician)|Viktor Afanasyev]] and [[Ivan Yefremov]] supported him.<ref>{{cite web | title=Библиотечный комплекс | url=https://lib.uni-dubna.ru/search/files/pk_idea/~pk_idea.htm }}</ref> 
Kuznetsov influenced [[Evald Ilyenkov]], with whom he was close friends in the 1950s.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://vox-journal.org/content/Vox%2025/Vox%2025-12-Penzin.pdf 
|title="Космология духа" Эвальда Ильенкова: опыт прочтения в свете современных философских дискуссий
|date= |accessdate=2022-02-22 |archive-date=2022-01-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220119142549/https://vox-journal.org/content/Vox%2025/Vox%2025-12-Penzin.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://moscowartmagazine.com/issue/85/article/1862 |title=А. Пензин. Коммунизм и энтропия в космологии Эвальда Ильенкова |publisher=Moscowartmagazine.com |date=2015-01-25 |accessdate=2022-02-22 |archive-date=2021-04-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210423022025/http://moscowartmagazine.com/issue/85/article/1862 |url-status=live }}</ref> Kuznetsov worked with [[Spartak Nikanorov]] (he met him in 1963,<ref>{{Cite web| title=Становление и развитие систем сетевого планирования и управления: опыт выдающихся советских ученых с.п. никанорова и п.г. кузнецова | language=ru | trans-title=Formation and development of network planning and management systems: the experience of outstanding Soviet scientists S.P. Nikanorov and P.G. Kuznetsov | url=https://raen.info/upload/redactorfiles/11_sham_93_101.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240910005226/https://raen.info/upload/redactorfiles/11_sham_93_101.pdf | archive-date=2024-09-10}}</ref> they will become friends<ref>{{cite journal | last1=а. а | first1=Рожков | url=https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/vydayuschiysya-uchenyy-kontseptualist-nikanorov-spartak-petrovich | title=Вы точно человек? | journal=Уголь | date=2023 | pages=24–26 }}</ref>).<ref>{{cite web | url=https://portalus.ru/modules/philosophy/rus_readme.php?subaction=showfull&id=1109059885&archive=0217b-2&start_from=&ucat=& | title=Философия для физтеха | date=2005 }}</ref> 

Kuznetsov called himself a student of Nikanorov and Ilyenkov.<ref>{{Cite web| title=Становление и развитие систем сетевого планирования и управления: опыт выдающихся советских ученых с.п. никанорова и п.г. кузнецова | language=ru | trans-title=Formation and development of network planning and management systems: the experience of outstanding Soviet scientists S.P. Nikanorov and P.G. Kuznetsov | url=https://raen.info/upload/redactorfiles/11_sham_93_101.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240910005226/https://raen.info/upload/redactorfiles/11_sham_93_101.pdf | archive-date=2024-09-10}}</ref>
Kuznetsov was influenced by [[Nicholas Georgescu-Roegen]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://zavtra.ru/blogs/nepriznannij_genij | title=Андрей Фурсов: Непризнанный гений }}</ref>

[[Lyndon LaRouche]] said that Kuznetsov was one of the first to understand the principles of [[physical economics]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=aOJwDwAAQBAJ&pg=PT104 | title=The Four Powers | last1=Larouche | first1=Lyndon | last2=Wertz | first2=William | last3=Maitra | first3=Ramtanu | last4=Jones | first4=William }}</ref>
